reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the shared getRangeAmount/getWorstCaseAmount helpers that forecast, schedules app, preview and getScheduledAmount already use, but leaves api-models.ts getExpectedAmount, a private copy of the old 'furthest from zero' range rule, untouched instead of pointing it at getRangeAmount.

duplication.why: Adds no logic of its own to duplicate; the only duplication is the existing api-models copy, which now disagrees with the shared helper.

placement.why: The edit is in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree defines the planned-amount rule.

scope.why: Two one-line rule changes, comment updates, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Simple and clear, but the API's expectedAmount keeps the old rule in a separate place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The diff goes through the shared helpers; the untouched api-models.ts getExpectedAmount copy was already there before the change.
